refPackage.statement: For measure spaces $\Omega_{01}$ and $\Omega_{02}$ (types each equipped with a canonical measure) and a measurable space $G$, $\mathrm{refPackage}(\Omega_{01},\Omega_{02},G)$ is the type (structure) whose elements consist of: a measurable function $X_{01} : \Omega_{01} \to G$, a measurable function $X_{02} : \Omega_{02} \to G$, and a real number $\eta$ satisfying $0 < \eta$ and $8\eta \le 1$. According to its docstring, it packages all the fixed information in the main argument (the reference random variables and the parameter $\eta$), so that when defining the $\tau$ functional one only needs to refer to the package once in the notation.

tau.statement:
Let $\Omega_{01}$ and $\Omega_{02}$ be measure spaces (types each equipped with a canonical measure, written $\mathrm{vol}$), let $G$ be an additive commutative group equipped with a measurable space structure, and let $p$ be an element of $\mathrm{refPackage}(\Omega_{01},\Omega_{02},G)$, i.e. a tuple consisting of measurable maps $p.X_{01} : \Omega_{01} 	o G$, $p.X_{02} : \Omega_{02} 	o G$ and a real number $p.\eta$ with $0 < p.\eta$ and $8\,p.\eta \le 1$. For measurable spaces $\Omega_1, \Omega_2$, functions $X_1 : \Omega_1 	o G$, $X_2 : \Omega_2 	o G$ and measures $\mu_1$ on $\Omega_1$, $\mu_2$ on $\Omega_2$, $	au[X_1;\mu_1 \,\#\, X_2;\mu_2 \mid p]$ is the real number $d[X_1;\mu_1 \,\#\, X_2;\mu_2] + p.\eta\, d[p.X_{01};\mathrm{vol} \,\#\, X_1;\mu_1] + p.\eta\, d[p.X_{02};\mathrm{vol} \,\#\, X_2;\mu_2]$. Here For measurable spaces $\Omega', \Omega''$, functions $Y : \Omega' 	o G$, $Z : \Omega'' 	o G$ and measures $\mu'$ on $\Omega'$, $\mu''$ on $\Omega''$, the Ruzsa distance is $d[Y;\mu' \,\#\, Z;\mu''] = H[(x,y) \mapsto x - y;\ Y_*\mu' \otimes Z_*\mu''] - 	frac12 H[Y;\mu'] - 	frac12 H[Z;\mu'']$, where $\otimes$ is the product measure on $G 	imes G$. For a measure $
u$ on a measurable space $S$, $\mathrm{H_m}[
u] = \sum_{s \in S} -t_s \log t_s$ (a possibly infinite sum, as a $\mathrm{tsum}$), where $t_s$ is the real value of $ ig((
u(S))^{-1}\cdot
u ig)(\{s\})$ (the entropy of the normalised measure); for a function $Y : \Omega' 	o S$ on a measurable space and a measure $\mu'$ on it, the entropy is $H[Y;\mu'] = \mathrm{H_m}[Y_*\mu']$, with $Y_*\mu'$ the pushforward measure.

TauMinimizes.statement:
Let $\Omega_{01}$ and $\Omega_{02}$ be measure spaces (types each equipped with a canonical measure, written $\mathrm{vol}$), let $G$ be an additive commutative group equipped with a measurable space structure, and let $p$ be an element of $\mathrm{refPackage}(\Omega_{01},\Omega_{02},G)$, i.e. a tuple consisting of measurable maps $p.X_{01} : \Omega_{01} 	o G$, $p.X_{02} : \Omega_{02} 	o G$ and a real number $p.\eta$ with $0 < p.\eta$ and $8\,p.\eta \le 1$. For a measure space $\Omega$ with canonical measure $\mathbb{P}$ and functions $X_1, X_2 : \Omega 	o G$, $\mathrm{TauMinimizes}(p, X_1, X_2)$ is the proposition that for all probability measures $
u_1, 
u_2$ on $G$, $	au[X_1;\mathbb{P} \,\#\, X_2;\mathbb{P} \mid p] \le 	au[\mathrm{id};
u_1 \,\#\, \mathrm{id};
u_2 \mid p]$, where $\mathrm{id} : G 	o G$ is the identity. Here, for measurable spaces $\Omega_1', \Omega_2'$, functions $Y_1 : \Omega_1' 	o G$, $Y_2 : \Omega_2' 	o G$ and measures $\mu_1'$, $\mu_2'$ on them, $	au[Y_1;\mu_1' \,\#\, Y_2;\mu_2' \mid p] = d[Y_1;\mu_1' \,\#\, Y_2;\mu_2'] + p.\eta\, d[p.X_{01};\mathrm{vol} \,\#\, Y_1;\mu_1'] + p.\eta\, d[p.X_{02};\mathrm{vol} \,\#\, Y_2;\mu_2']$. For measurable spaces $\Omega', \Omega''$, functions $Y : \Omega' 	o G$, $Z : \Omega'' 	o G$ and measures $\mu'$ on $\Omega'$, $\mu''$ on $\Omega''$, the Ruzsa distance is $d[Y;\mu' \,\#\, Z;\mu''] = H[(x,y) \mapsto x - y;\ Y_*\mu' \otimes Z_*\mu''] - 	frac12 H[Y;\mu'] - 	frac12 H[Z;\mu'']$, where $\otimes$ is the product measure on $G 	imes G$. For a measure $
u$ on a measurable space $S$, $\mathrm{H_m}[
u] = \sum_{s \in S} -t_s \log t_s$ (a possibly infinite sum, as a $\mathrm{tsum}$), where $t_s$ is the real value of $ ig((
u(S))^{-1}\cdot
u ig)(\{s\})$ (the entropy of the normalised measure); for a function $Y : \Omega' 	o S$ on a measurable space and a measure $\mu'$ on it, the entropy is $H[Y;\mu'] = \mathrm{H_m}[Y_*\mu']$, with $Y_*\mu'$ the pushforward measure.
